gaps.description: The frontend adapter targets the NODE-17 /api/v1/projects resource and isolates parsing/request mapping, but the exact deployed create+brief payload and response schema still require OpenAPI/real API conformance evidence before COMPLETE.
gaps.completion_evidence: Contract test generated from the deployed OpenAPI schema plus create/list/detail requests against a real API instance, including 400/401/403/409/422 behavior.

gaps.description: The dashboard currently loads the project collection then filters/sorts on the server-rendered page. Production-scale cursor pagination and backend search/status filtering are not yet wired.
gaps.completion_evidence: Cursor-aware list adapter and UI with backend q/status/sort contract, tested for empty/next/previous/filter combinations.

gaps.description: Project creation and brief display are implemented. Post-create brief editing, optimistic concurrency/version conflict UX, project status transitions, and archive/restore are not yet exposed in NODE-53.
gaps.completion_evidence: Version-aware brief edit/status/archive UI using NODE-17 concurrency contracts with conflict recovery tests.

gaps.description: No real browser E2E currently proves list → filter → create → detail → workspace handoff with authenticated tenant data.
gaps.completion_evidence: Browser E2E against a seeded API covering zero/one/many projects, validation errors, idempotent resubmission, detail rendering, and workspace handoff.

gaps.description: NODE-53 Hosted CI has not yet produced executed-step evidence; prior stacked nodes are blocked before runner steps start.
gaps.completion_evidence: NODE-53 workflow with non-empty executed steps and passing static contract, TypeScript check, and production build.
